CHD-1.2 How much ORS to give Age ORS after each loose stool --- --- Up to 2 years 50 to 100 ml 2 years or more 100 to 200 ml - Give frequent small sips from a cup (or spoon). If the child vomits, wait 10 minutes , then continue more slowly. - Continue giving extra fluid until the diarrhoea stops. Give the mother 2 packets of ORS to use at (CHD-1.2).
